metadata.title: Move_SAP_MAXDB_BKP_NewDate
metadata.description: SAP Admin already taking backup through SAP to a Folder. Can't run netbackup client due to concerns. So plan is to create a folder with current date as name in Netapp and also delete the folder that's 14 days old , then netbackup will copy them to VTL.This PowerShell Script to Create Backup Folder Based on Date,then move the SAP Fiori DB backup files, then delete the old backup folder from last two weeks.The only UNIQUE thing about this script being the usage of variables with date. otherwise move and delete scripts are already there in PS gallery.
